title: Spacious, Clean & Always On Time
subtitle: Well-maintained Mercedes-Benz, Toyota Vellfire, and HiAce minibuses driven by experienced, licensed chauffeurs.

vehicles.name: 6 Seater Maxi Cab
vehicles.description: Comfortable Toyota Vellfire or Alphard — great for small groups and city rides.
vehicles.heroDescription: The 6-Seater Maxi Cab is perfect for corporate and city point-to-point transfers. Powered by the Toyota Vellfire or Alphard, this vehicle offers discreet luxury with enough space for up to 6 passengers and 4–5 bags.

vehicles.name: 7 Seater Maxi Cab
vehicles.description: Roomy Toyota Vellfire or Alphard — ideal for families and airport pickups.
vehicles.heroDescription: The 7-Seater Maxi Cab delivers maximum versatility with premium leather captain seating. Perfect for airport arrivals with extra luggage, family outings, and corporate executive transfers.

vehicles.name: 9 Seater Maxi Cab
vehicles.description: Perfect mid-size option for group airport transfers and business travel.
vehicles.heroDescription: A spacious 9-passenger cabin engineered for comfortable group transit across Singapore. Features ample legroom, generous headroom, and substantial luggage capacity for medium-sized teams.

vehicles.name: 13 Seater Minibus
vehicles.description: Spacious minibus for larger groups, corporate visitors, and special events.
vehicles.heroDescription: Our flagship high-capacity minibus comfortably seats up to 13 passengers with a dedicated rear luggage compartment. The premier choice for event shuttles, delegational transfers, and wedding convoys.

vehicles.name: VIP Lounge 7-Seater
vehicles.description: Luxury lounge seating with reclining captain chairs and ambient lighting.
vehicles.heroDescription: The ultimate luxury chauffeur experience in Singapore. Crafted for VIP delegates, celebrities, and corporate leaders with plush leather reclining seats, ambient cabin illumination, and discreet chauffeur etiquette.
inclusions: Flight tracking with complimentary airport buffer
Reclining leather captain chairs & ambient lighting
Bottled mineral water & onboard phone chargers

vehicles.name: Wheelchair Maxi Cab
vehicles.description: Built-in wheelchair ramp with secure safety harness for safe hospital and home transfers.
vehicles.heroDescription: Specially modified wheelchair accessible maxi cab equipped with a heavy-duty hydraulic ramp, 4-point wheelchair floor restraint system, and lap/shoulder seat belts for dignified and safe mobility across Singapore.
inclusions: Spacious cabin for caregivers and family

bottomBanner.title: +5 More Vehicles
bottomBanner.description: Sedans, MPVs, Toyota Alphard VIP, and wheelchair-accessible vans also available.
